name: kcmps-checkout-lambdas
description: Dependencies for backend/checkout/*.js (Module 1 — Sales & Order, the customer-facing checkout half). Deploy each .js file as its own Lambda function (or bundle with esbuild/Lambda layers) — this package.json is a single reference for `npm install` before zipping/uploading. Also requires ../lib (backend/lib) alongside on the Lambda's module path.
